query:
SELECT
               v.id AS variant_id,
               p.name AS product_name,
               v.attributes,
               v.sku,
               v.barcode,
               l.counted_stock
           FROM stocktake_lines l
           JOIN product_variants v ON v.id = l.variant_id
           JOIN products p ON p.id = v.product_id
           WHERE l.stocktake_id = $1
             AND (LOWER(v.barcode) = LOWER($2) OR LOWER(v.sku) = LOWER($2))
           ORDER BY v.id
